hank.name: Setup Codon
hank.promptText: Create a directory called 'notes' in <%PROJECT_DIR%> if it doesn't exist. Then create a file at <%PROJECT_DIR%>/notes/setup_complete.txt with the text 'Setup complete'.

hank.name: Extending Codon
hank.promptText: Write a short poem (4 lines) about nature and save it to <%PROJECT_DIR%>/notes/poem_1.txt
hank.description: A codon that will extend multiple times
hank.exhaustWithPrompt: Continue writing more poems. Write another short 4-line poem about a different topic and save it to <%PROJECT_DIR%>/notes/poem_<TIMESTAMP>.txt. Make each poem unique.

hank.name: Final Codon After Extensions
hank.promptText: Create a summary file at <%PROJECT_DIR%>/notes/summary.txt listing all the poem files you can find in the notes directory.
hank.description: Final codon to verify workflow continues after extensions
